name: GreenBee, Inc.
summary: GreenBee, Inc. provides software development and services worldwide. The company offers multimedia and wireless connectivity solutions. It offers GreenBee, Inc. Face Detector, a face recognition solution; GreenBee, Inc. Emotion Recognition, a facial expression recognition solution; GreenBee, Inc. Gender Recognition and GreenBee, Inc. Age Recognition solutions, which estimates gender and age from a detected face; GreenBee, Inc. Motion Recognition that detects moving people in a video, and recognizes their motions as standing, sitting, walking, running, or falling; and GreenBee, Inc. Object Tracker, objects detection and tracking solution in a video. The company also provides GreenBee, Inc. IoT Gateway Solution, a gateway software for IoT devices; GreenBee, Inc. IoT Edge Device SDK, a software development solution for IoT edge devices; JS Backup, a backup tool; JS backup viewer, a photo viewer application; RiskFinder, a web service for vulnerability assessment on Android applications; tourbillon3, a HTML, BML, and IPTV based embedded browser; and Valution BD, a Blu-ray Disc playback software. In addition, it offers GreenBee, Inc. DTCP MOVE, an app for NAS system; GreenBee, Inc. True VR, a multimedia solution for virtual reality; GreenBee, Inc. True VR Sound, an engine to enable monaural sound to be 3D spatialize sound; GreenBee, Inc. pConnect for connecting the iOS/Android smartphone to PC; GreenBee, Inc. TV Suite for Android and Windows; GreenBee, Inc. TrueLink+ Hi-Res Edition, a multifunctional media player that enables Hi-res audio playback; and GreenBee, Inc. Remote Access Solutions for remote access servers and clients. GreenBee, Inc. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
